propositions: The snapshot janitor's absolute free-space watermark (2 GiB) is disk-size-blind and only triggers at 93.3% used on a 30-GiB volume, above the 85% alarm floor and the incident's 90% peak, making reclaim structurally unreachable before alarm conditions.

The volume-relative watermark term must be the larger of the absolute floor and a percentage of total volume capacity, with hysteresis to overshoot the trigger threshold rather than re-firing on every interval.
A fractional free-watermark value must be avoided because the config seam truncates via int() and silently disables the term; the new knob is whole integer percentage points.

The janitor correctly evicted nothing throughout the incident because its eviction predicates were never met—the absolute watermark blocked, the 7-day cold-trim exceeded container lifetime, and the promised byte-total backstop was not implemented.
